text: What's the earliest thing you can remember? Where were you, and who was there?
Describe the house you grew up in. Walk me through it, room by room.
Tell me about your mom. What was she like when you were little?
Tell me about your dad. What's something he taught you?
Who were your brothers, sisters or cousins growing up, and what did you get up to together?
What did you love to do on a summer day as a kid?
Tell me about a time you got in trouble as a kid.
What was your favourite holiday growing up, and how did your family celebrate it?
Did you have a pet when you were young? Tell me about it.
Who was your best friend as a kid, and what's a favourite memory with them?
What was school like for you? Tell me about a teacher you remember.
What was your first car, and where did you go in it?
What music did you listen to as a teenager, and where were you when you heard it?
What was your first job, and what did you learn from it?
Tell me about a friend from your teenage years and something you did together.
What's something you were really proud of as a teenager?
Tell me about the first place you lived on your own.
How did you meet your partner or a close friend? What do you remember about that day?
Tell me about your wedding day.
What work did you do in your twenties, and what was a typical day like?
Tell me about a trip or adventure from when you were young.
What was a hard time in your early adult life, and how did you get through it?
Tell me about the work you're proudest of.
Tell me about a place you've lived that felt like home, and why.
What's a family tradition you love? How did it start?
Tell me about a time someone helped you when you really needed it.
What's the best vacation you've ever taken? What happened?
Tell me about someone you miss, and a memory of them you treasure.
What's a project you built or fixed with your own hands?
What did you do this week that you'd like to remember?
Tell me about a pet you have or had. What are they like?
What does a good day look like for you these days?
What's something that made you laugh recently?
What are you looking forward to this year?
Tell me any memory you'd like me to keep. Start with when it was and who was there.
